reuse.why: Extracts the category query the average actions already shared into getCategoriesForBulkAction and points setZero at it; copyPreviousMonth keeps using getBudgetData with its own check.

duplication.why: Removes three copies of the bulk-category query, but the hidden/group-hidden/saved-template rule is now stated twice: as SQL (c.hidden = 0 AND g.hidden = 0 AND c.goal_def IS NULL) and as a JS condition in copyPreviousMonth.

placement.why: The selection helper lives in server/budget/actions.ts beside getBudgetData, where the month-wide actions are.

scope.why: Limited to the month-wide actions plus tests; single-category actions untouched.

maintainability.why: A named selection function is easy to own, though the copy-previous path decides the same rule separately and goal_def is typed as unknown in BudgetData.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No existing abstraction is bypassed; the diff creates the shared selection itself.

disguised_duplication.where: copyPreviousMonth in server/budget/actions.ts re-expresses the same exclusion rule as a JS condition (hidden, group_hidden, goal_def !== null) instead of SQL, so the rule exists twice in different shapes.

one_place.where: The rule lands in getCategoriesForBulkAction's WHERE clause for setZero/set3/6/12MonthAvg, but copyPreviousMonth applies it separately in its own forEach condition.
